page_title: UNI 1-2 MON | Union Berlin v B. Monchengladbach 15/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

90+6' Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the bottom left corner, but Moritz Nicolas is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.
90+4' PENALTY APPEAL by B. Monchengladbach, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
90+3' 2:5 – this is the current number of shots on target.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Philipp Sander (B. Monchengladbach) takes the corner kick, but Frederik Ronnow reads it well and stops the effort.
87' This shall not pass! Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Marin Ljubicic (Union Berlin) is coming onto the pitch as Woo-Yeong Jeong cannot continue after picking up an injury.
82' Gerardo Seoane prepares a substitution. Robin Hack is replaced by Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach).
82' Substitution. Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) in, Kevin Stoger out.

80' Excellent touch by Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach)! He latches on to a precise pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a terrific save.
78' The foul by Philipp Sander (B. Monchengladbach) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Sven Jablonski.
76' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.

75' Sven Jablonski blows his whistle and it's Laszlo Benes (Union Berlin) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. There is a free kick near the sideline to B. Monchengladbach.
74' Gerardo Seoane decides to make a substitution. Joe Scally will be replaced by Stefan Lainer (B. Monchengladbach).
74' Here comes a substitution. Nathan Ngoumou is given a rest as he is replaced by Marvin Friedrich (B. Monchengladbach).
73' Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Sven Jablonski blows his whistle for a foul. B. Monchengladbach win a free kick.
70' Laszlo Benes (Union Berlin) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
67' The corner from Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) is intercepted by the defence.
66' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Union Berlin.
63' Steffen Baumgart has decided to make a change. Laszlo Benes (Union Berlin) replaces Janik Haberer.
63' That's the end of the game for Andrej Ilic, who is replaced by Ivan Prtajin (Union Berlin).
63' 1 - 2 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Moritz Nicolas no chance!
63' Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
61' It’s a PENALTY to Union Berlin after the VAR review!
60' There's a break in play and referee Sven Jablonski must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Union Berlin using VAR. This could be interesting!
59' One of the Union Berlin players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.

58' Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball has crossed the sideline. Union Berlin are taking a throw-in.
55' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the middle of the goal was easily saved by Moritz Nicolas.
52' The resulting corner from Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
51' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
50' Great teamplay by Union Berlin as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
49' Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
46' Steffen Baumgart makes a half-time substitution. Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) comes on in place of Tim Skarke.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+7' Sven Jablonski has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45+6' Benedict Hollerbach sprays a pass out to Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin), but he produces a poor effort from inside the box which goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.
45+5' Union Berlin control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
45+4' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

45+3' A pass travels right across the box to Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper in the bottom right corner, but Frederik Ronnow denies him with a decent save. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach have been awarded a corner kick.
45+2' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) latches onto a short pass just on the edge of the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper but comes back off the crossbar. Close!
45+1' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
45' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' The Union Berlin players are exchanging some short passes.
43' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

42' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) reacts superbly inside the box to get first to the rebound. From about the penalty spot he produces a header towards the bottom left corner, but Frederik Ronnow pulls off a magnificent save to keep the ball out of the net. The ball is out of play. B. Monchengladbach win a corner kick.
42' The resulting set piece from B. Monchengladbach is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
41' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. B. Monchengladbach force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

38' A precise low pass is received by Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
38' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach).
37' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. B. Monchengladbach force their opponents to concede a corner.

36' It looks like Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) saw red with that tackle. Sven Jablonski won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to B. Monchengladbach.
30' Problems for Steffen Baumgart as Robert Skov (Union Berlin) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Tom Rothe replaces him.
28' The game is interrupted now, Robert Skov (Union Berlin) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
26' 0 - 2 Beautiful move! Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) latches on to a brilliant pass and aims accurately beyond the helpless goalkeeper. Great action there!
25' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
25' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Now Union Berlin have a corner.

21' Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) shows good awareness deep inside the box and jumps high to meet a perfect cross from the set piece. He steers a fine header goalwards, but finds the keeper prepared. No doubt about the wonderful save that he made.

21' Sven Jablonski blows his whistle as Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack. Union Berlin are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
19' Gerardo Seoane is forced to make a change. Moritz Nicolas is unable to continue due to injury, Jonas Omlin (B. Monchengladbach) comes on.
16' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
15' The B. Monchengladbach players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
13' 38:62 – the ratio of ball possession.
10' 0 - 1 After receiving a sweet pass, Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach) unleashes a shot straight into the top left corner. Good team effort!
9' Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) commits a rough foul. Sven Jablonski stops the game and makes a call. Union Berlin are awarded a free kick.
8' B. Monchengladbach seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

4' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) leaps high to meet a lofted pass around the penalty spot, but his header crashes against the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.
3' Neat passing move from B. Monchengladbach in order to create new attacking opportunities.
2' Wonderful movement. Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) connects with a cross inside the box and plants a header goalwards, but Moritz Nicolas makes a superb save.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and B. Monchengladbach will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Sven Jablonski.
